exam.title: Kiểm tra 30 phút Chapter 2: Safety at Work

questions.question: Protects the head from accidental injury.
questions.explanation: the head (đầu) → safety helmet, mũ bảo hộ.

questions.question: Protect ears against noise.
questions.explanation: ears … noise (tai, tiếng ồn) → ear protectors.

questions.question: A safety sign which warns you of danger.
questions.explanation: warns you of danger (cảnh báo nguy hiểm) → hazard sign.

questions.question: A safety sign which tells you what you must not do.
questions.explanation: must not (không được) → prohibition sign, biển cấm. Mandatory là must do.

questions.question: Protects the body against welding work.
questions.explanation: the body … welding → protective apron, tạp dề bảo hộ.

questions.question: Avoids the worker falling.
questions.explanation: falling (rơi ngã) → safety harness, dây đai an toàn.

questions.question: Protect knees on the ground while working.
questions.explanation: knees (đầu gối) → knee pads.

questions.question: Damage to one or more ligaments in a joint.
questions.explanation: ligaments in a joint (dây chằng ở khớp) → sprain, bong gân.

questions.question: Too much use of physical or mental energy; hard work.
questions.explanation: too much use of energy → overexertion, gắng sức quá mức.

questions.question: A space with limited entry that is not suitable for people.
questions.explanation: limited entry (lối vào hạn chế) → confined areas, không gian hẹp, kín.

questions.question:
Article 1
At most shops the work environment is well-lighted and properly ventilated. However some shops are drafty and noisy. Moreover, on a hot summer or frigid winter day shop temperatures are not always ideal. Some shops that specialize in oil changes and lubrication use an arrangement commonly called a pit. Customers drive their vehicles into the shop. The mechanic then enters the pit to perform the work. Pit areas are typically not well-ventilated and can be hot during summer months. The very nature of the work also means that mechanics can seldom avoid handling greasy and dirty parts. According to the latest Statistics, the rate of illnesses and injuries is higher for mechanics than the national average rate. Part of the risk comes from lifting heavy tools, equipment or parts. Other injuries, such as small burns, bruises or cuts, are caused from contact with hot or sharp parts, the need to reach into confined areas or having a tool slip under pressure. Strains and sprains were also common and were typically caused by overexertion. Technicians may work as a team or be assisted by an apprentice or helper when doing heavy work, such as removing engines and transmissions. Many employers provide uniforms, locker rooms, and shower facilities. Most automotive service technicians and mechanics work a standard 40 hour week. Some may work evenings and weekends to satisfy customer service needs.

Some shops that specialize in oil changes and lubrication use an arrangement commonly called a ______.
questions.explanation: Article 1: an arrangement commonly called a pit.

questions.question:
Article 2
Fire kills, often very quickly. It is important to know exactly what to do if a fire breaks out. Lives may depend on it. If you find a fire, do not try to put it out yourself. Break the cover on the nearest alarm button and press it hard. All staff should know where these are. Dial 114 to call the fire brigade. Leave by the nearest exit. Close all the doors. Assist any service users near you. Go to the assembly point. Do not stop to collect belongings. Do not go back into the building until you have been told it is safe to do so.

Dial ______ to call the fire brigade.
questions.explanation: Article 2: Dial 114 to call the fire brigade.

questions.question: A ______ sign shows where fire equipment and fire alarms are.
questions.explanation: fire equipment and fire alarms → fire safety sign.

questions.question: Wear a ______ to avoid inhaling dust, vapours and fumes.
questions.explanation: inhaling (hít vào) bụi, khói → protective mask.

questions.question: Many employers provide uniforms, ______ rooms and shower facilities.
questions.explanation: locker rooms = phòng thay đồ có tủ cá nhân.

questions.question: Work at height needs a safety ______ to avoid falling.
questions.explanation: avoid falling → safety harness.

questions.question: Lifting heavy parts is a ______ to your back, so wear a dorsal belt.
questions.explanation: a risk to your back = nguy cơ cho lưng.

questions.question: Choose the correct translation: "However, some shops are drafty and noisy."
options: Tuy nhiên, một số xưởng có gió lùa và ồn.
Vì vậy, mọi xưởng đều yên tĩnh.
Tuy nhiên, một số xưởng rất sạch và sáng.
Hơn nữa, xưởng nào cũng nóng.
questions.explanation: However = tuy nhiên; drafty and noisy = có gió lùa và ồn.

questions.question: Choose the correct translation: "Do not stop to collect belongings."
options: Đừng dừng lại để lấy đồ đạc cá nhân.
Hãy dừng lại để lấy đồ đạc cá nhân.
questions.explanation: Do not = đừng; belongings = đồ đạc cá nhân.

questions.question: Choose the correct translation: "Many employers provide uniforms, locker rooms, and shower facilities."
options: Nhiều thợ học việc mặc đồng phục và đi tắm.
Nhiều chủ doanh nghiệp cung cấp đồng phục, phòng thay đồ và khu nhà tắm.
Một số xưởng không có phòng thay đồ.
Chủ doanh nghiệp yêu cầu thợ tự mua đồng phục.
questions.explanation: provide = cung cấp; locker rooms = phòng thay đồ; shower facilities = khu nhà tắm.

A technician may be assisted by an apprentice for heavy work.
